name: npm/@tacticlaunch/mcp-linear
title: Linear
description: Issues, roadmaps, and project delivery in Linear.

toolsSummary.name: linear_getIssues
toolsSummary.description: List and filter issues across teams and projects.

toolsSummary.name: linear_getIssueById
toolsSummary.description: Load an issue by ID or key (e.g. PROJ-12).

toolsSummary.name: linear_createIssue
toolsSummary.description: Create a new issue in a team.

toolsSummary.name: linear_updateIssue
toolsSummary.description: Update fields, state, and assignment on an issue.

toolsSummary.name: linear_searchIssues
toolsSummary.description: Search with filters, including text and state.

io.sami/gallery.about: MCP server for the Linear GraphQL API: issues, projects, teams, comments, labels, and cycles, driven by a personal API token in Sami or your environment.

environmentVariables.name: LINEAR_API_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Personal API key from Linear (Settings — API).
